description: Tip or reimburse a worker after their work on a bounty you own is released. Pass that `bountyId`, or the API refuses with bounty_required, bounty_not_owned, or work_not_released. Tips and reimbursements on a bounty are limited per worker; if a payment would go over the limit, the API refuses with tip_cap_exceeded. The API uses wallet balance first and otherwise returns a hosted checkout URL (no checkout when idempotencyKey is set); tell the operator checkoutTotal (what checkout will charge, including the platform fee) before they pay. Other refusals carry an error message; show it to the operator. Use `description` as a free-text memo. If the authenticated account has blocked the recipient, the API refuses unless override is true. Requires RENTAHUMAN_API_KEY.
